scripts.gen:types: bun run gen:schema && bun run gen:operations
scripts.dev: bun run gen:types && bun run gen:routes && bun run build:graphiql && bun run --parallel dev:assets:vite dev:assets:graphiql
scripts.dev:assets: bun run gen:operations && bun run gen:routes && bun run build:graphiql && bun run --parallel dev:assets:codegen dev:assets:vite dev:assets:graphiql
scripts.dev:assets:codegen: cargo watch --postpone -w graphql -w apps/web/src/graphql -w apps/web/codegen.ts -s 'cd apps/web && bun run gen:operations'
scripts.dev:assets:graphiql: cargo watch --postpone -w apps/web/graphiql.html -w apps/web/src/graphiql.tsx -w apps/web/src/graphiql.css -w apps/web/vite.graphiql.config.ts -s 'cd apps/web && bun run build:graphiql'
scripts.dev:tauri: bun run gen:types && bun run gen:routes && vite --config vite.desktop.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort
scripts.build: bun run gen:types && bun run gen:routes && vite build && bun run build:graphiql
scripts.build:assets: bun run gen:operations && bun run gen:routes && vite build && bun run build:graphiql
scripts.build:tauri: bun run gen:types && bun run gen:routes && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts
scripts.check:generated: bun run gen:types && bun run gen:routes && bun run scripts/check-generated-clean.ts
scripts.lint: bun run gen:types && bun run gen:routes && tsc --noEmit && eslint src --max-warnings=0
